newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach down as Merrill downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach down as Merrill downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Stagecoach Plc dropped on Wednesday as analysts at Merrill Lynch cut the stock to "neutral" from "accumulate," market sources said.

Wednesday's decline extended Tuesday's losses after brokerage UBS said it planned to sell up to 35 million shares in the company, held by shareholders of Porterbrook after the rolling stock leasing company was bought by Stagecoach last year.
Stagecoach shares were down 25-1/2p at 752-1/2 by 1101 GMT.
Analysts at Merrill were not immediately available for comment.
